tha-ap250:1.1: Pāṭalipūjaka.] Satta pāṭalipupphāni sīse katvān' ahaṃ tadā / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Vessabhumhi naruttame. // //
tha-ap250:2.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi pupphapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
